thread:
zoe-support: Hey team, Acme SE reports our JSON-mode consumer suddenly started throwing parse errors this morning after a weekend spike. They pasted the exact response and it's not a simple missing comma — looks like NDJSON + a debug line.
liam-eng-runtime: Can you paste the raw response and the request they sent? Also which model variant did routing pick?
customer-se-acme: Here's the request (they set `response_format: json` and `mode: structured`):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"prompt":"export items","response_format":"json","max_tokens":200}'
```
customer-se-acme: Raw body returned (exact bytes):
```
X-VARIANT: q4f-compact
{"items": [{"id": "a1","value": 3}]}
{"items": [{"id": "a2","value": 5}]}
NOTE: truncated to fit token budget
```
nina-eng-ml: Whoa — so the response has a leading header line starting with `X-VARIANT:` and then multiple JSON objects separated by newlines (NDJSON), plus a trailing human note. That will break consumers expecting a single JSON object.
zoe-support: Exactly. Customer's client library calls JSON.parse on the response body and fails. They only see failures when traffic is routed to q4f-compact. When routed to the baseline model it returns a single JSON object as expected.
liam-eng-runtime: Hypothesis: smart-routing fallback to a compact quantized variant returns streaming/partial NDJSON for multimodal batching, and our response-sanitizer didn't run for that variant. Could be an output_transform bug for quantized variants.
sam-product: Is this a recent change? Any deploys or routing config edits over the weekend?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed release 2026.04.02-compact-routing-fixes to canary at 1712344800 by liam-eng-runtime
nina-eng-ml: That deploy touched variant routing heuristics and a small change to how we annotate responses for debugging. It may have introduced the leading debug line for compact variants.
liam-eng-runtime: Repro steps for us:
1) Send the same request with `model: auto` to hit smart-routing.
2) Force route to q4f-compact by setting `model: q4f-compact` and compare bodies.
3) Check `response_transform` logs in the serving runtime for that request id.
zoe-support: Customer provided a failing request id: r-49f3c2. Can someone pull logs?
liam-eng-runtime: Pulling logs now — found r-49f3c2. Serving log shows: `variant=q4f-compact, route=cheap-region, transform_stage=skipped, reason=transform-runtime-mismatch`. Also `annotate_debug: true` in runtime config.
nina-eng-ml: So transform was skipped because our runtime couldn't apply the structured-output transformer to the quantized kernel — fallback path left raw chunks + debug header. That explains NDJSON + header.
sam-product: Impact: any customers using structured/json mode who get routed to these compact variants will see parse failures. We need a mitigation ASAP.
liam-eng-runtime: Immediate mitigation options:
• Disable annotate_debug for compact variants (quick config flip)
• Force structured-output transforms to run in a compatibility mode for quantized variants (riskier)
• Add a server-side cleanup step to coalesce NDJSON into a single JSON wrapper when `response_format=json` is requested.
zoe-support: Customer asks for ETA and workaround. They can pin `model: baseline-v1` for now but that's not ideal.
nina-eng-ml: I can push a compatibility patch that forces the transform to run as CPU post-process for compact variants. Time estimate ~3h to roll to canary, test, then prod if ok.
liam-eng-runtime: I'll flip annotate_debug off for the compact pool as an emergency rollback. That should remove the `X-VARIANT:` debug line immediately. ETA ~15m.
sam-product: Good. Zoe, tell the customer: temporary workarounds are pin to baseline or wait ~30m for rollback. We'll follow up with permanent fix timeline.
zoe-support: Confirming I told them to pin or wait. They'll try pinning now and report back.
customer-se-acme: Pinning to `baseline-v1` resolved the parse errors. Thanks for the quick help. Can you also share postmortem when fixed? We need assurance for production.
liam-eng-runtime: Rollback complete: `annotate_debug` disabled for q4f pools at 1712345750. Observability: dropping debug headers on new requests.
nina-eng-ml: Starting compatibility patch now. I'll update thread when canary passes.
Action items:
- nina-eng-ml: compatibility transform patch (ETA 3h)
- liam-eng-runtime: follow up on why transform runtime mismatch occurred (ETA 1d)
- sam-product: coordinate customer comms and postmortem (ETA 1d)
zoe-support: Thanks. Logging this as support ticket SUP-2026-1129 and escalating to SEs. Please cc me on postmortem.
sam-product: Noted. Also will add a schema-contract test that runs against smart-routing variants in CI so we catch NDJSON/annotations in the future.
zoe-support: Closing loop with customer. Leaving thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
